info.name: Adventuring Gear
info.description: Adventuring Gear from Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

element.name: Kindred Vitae
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: Vitae, blood from within a Kindred, has powerful properties that are passed on when imbibed by a non-Kindred. A single Blood Point can be stored in a drinkable vessel for up to 48 hours without alchemical treatment. When you drink this potion, you gain the following effects.
Increased Strength and Speed: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Speed increases by 5 feet for 1 week.
Increased Vitality: You gain 2d6 Temporary Hit Points.
Reduced Aging: You physically ignore the next year of natural aging.

However, mortals who drink this potion are more susceptible to the powers of the Undead. For the period of 1 year, you have Disadvantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened by Undead.

setters.set: strength, ability score increase, speed, temporary hit points, aging, undead, disadvantage, saves, charmed, frightened

element.name: Leather Undervest
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: These layered leather patches are worn under clothing or armor. The vest fits over the upper chest and back, protecting several internal organs from puncture, particularly the heart. While wearing a leather undervest, you gain the following benefits.
Underarmor. The leather undervest can be worn with any type of armor.
Limited Flexibility. The undervest allows a max Dexterity modifier of 3.

Pierce Protection. When you're hit by an attack while you're wearing a leather undervest, any Piercing damage dealt to you by that attack is reduced by 2. In addition, Intelligence (Medicine) checks to stake you in the heart have Disadvantage.
